messages.text:
Hey <@249007223454433292>! 👋 We checked your nation's data and logs (Chelovka) to trace exactly where your Consumer Goods and Iron went:

**1. Consumer Goods (CG) & Weight Display**
• **Units & Display:** In the database, resources are measured in kg. In the UI, weights above 1,000 kg are displayed in tonnes (**t**):
  - 1,000,000 kg (1M units) = **1,000 t**.
  When you had "1 million CG", that was **1,000 t**. Your 407t and 180t balances are 407,000 kg and 180,000 kg.
• **Consumption:** Chelovka has over **407.5M citizens** across 71 provinces. Every hourly tax tick, citizens consume CG, granting you the full **1.5x Consumer Goods Tax multiplier** (+50% bonus tax income!).
  - Demographic CG need: ~6,201 kg/hr
  - Production from 708 Distribution Centers: ~3,289 kg/hr
  - **Net consumption:** ~2,912 kg/hr = **~70 t/day** (~3 t/hr).
• **Revenue Page (-48.02 t/day):** When your screenshot showed -48 t/day, retail capacity bottlenecked deliveries. As more distribution centers finished building (now 708), capacity scaled up to ~70 t/day. Going from 407t to 180t was ~75 hours of normal consumption, giving you the full 1.5x tax boost.

**2. Iron & Pumpjacks Math**
• **Pumpjack Cost:** Each pumpjack costs **22,000 kg (22 t) Iron**.
  - 1,000 pumpjacks = **22,000,000 Iron (22M)**. Your 22M iron was the exact cost for 1,000 pumpjacks.
• **Purchases:** You bought 255 + 600 + 200 = **1,055 pumpjacks**, which consumed **23.21M Iron** (using up all 22M iron).
• **Extra 155 Pumpjacks:** Scheduling 155 more pumpjacks (total 1,210) requires **26.62M Iron** total, which is why you were short of iron for those additional 155.
• **Steel Mills:** Chelovka also currently owns **100 Steel Mills**. Each mill consumes 67 kg iron/hr, using **6,700 kg iron/hr** (~161 t/day), so iron is also continuously consumed there.

Everything is working as intended and no resources were lost! Let us know if you have any questions! 😊
